title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
prompt:
Given a string `s`, find the length of the longest substring with **no repeated characters**.

**Example**: `"abcabcbb"` → `3` (`"abc"`).

The variable-size window template verbatim: grow right; while the new character is a duplicate, shrink from the left.

tests.note: window must shrink past the FIRST d only

hints: Window state: a HashSet of the characters currently inside [l..r].
Before adding s.charAt(r): while the set already contains it, remove s.charAt(l) and l++.
Record `r - l + 1` after the window becomes valid.

solution.explanation: O(n): l and r each traverse the string once. The while-loop evicts from the left exactly until the duplicate of c leaves — the set then admits c. Test "dvdf" is the one that catches broken shrink logic.
